content: Runic Script  Ancient Alien language in Earth Reborn Series ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Quniform  -  An ancient script used by the aliens.  Its  a programming language  Using basic concepts of programming for spells and properties Adding it on objects gives them special properties Weapons and clothing are etched with these symbols Adding it on  there  bodies gives them greater power The Order  Tatoos  it  giving  them a slight advantage over those that don’t The Queen found the text which told of carving it into the skin works better Carving out the symbol down to the muscle and replacing it with symbols is the best Language Structure  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Format Written in vertical rows, right to left and bottom to top, the lower right corner is the beginning of the script The rows are neat and need to be inline and centered  A spell or item is written in what’s called a Bloc, a bloc is typically separated with a symbol that starts and ends the BLOC Intent The first symbol is the intent of the spell or bloc Guard - guarding a person or thing Attack - attacking a person or thing Motion - a movement spell Increase - an enhancement spell Sight - viewing something  Decrease - nullify or minimize Control - controlling something Target This is the target of the bloc Self - this is you  Scribed - the item its inscribed on Target - this is your target Intended - this is what the item is pointed at  All - everyone targeted Hostile - all hostiles Passive - all  non hostiles Minded - pictured in magi’s mind. Class Type used in spell (Elemental  poperty ) Decisions If than or else  Valuation Equals, greater than, less than Action What does it do fire, get, levitate  etc Focuser Symbols used to focus power Diffusers Nullifies specific or all powers Descriptor Names, custom items
